title: Account activity reads for active runtimes

effect.user: Account activity reports skip pending work reads whose result cannot affect a booting/running classification.
assertions: Active/recent/pending counts, ongoing units and observed claim IDs remain exact.
Inactive pending work, transfer generation ownership, fresh reads and reopen remain supported.

idle.why: No process/provider launch; this workload isolates one synchronous activity calculation.

background.why: No process/provider launch; this workload isolates one synchronous activity calculation.

release.why: No process/provider launch; this workload isolates one synchronous activity calculation.

recovery.why: Lifecycle freshness and reopen are separate behavioral controls.

fixture.seed: Two local fixture accounts; alternating mail/command pending work and booting/running states; three rounds.

recipe.readiness: Isolated store seeded; wrappers installed after fixture construction.
recipe.completion: Twelve retained samples with exact activity/state parity, zero active pending-work reads, and behavioral controls.
recipe.teardown: Always close store and remove owned fixture directory, including initial-open failure.

metrics.scope: undeliveredMessages and listCommands calls for active runtime bees in one public nodeActivity read
metrics.invariant: All twelve complete samples have exact facts and no durable changes; zero pending-work reads for booting/running bees.

gaps: Admission still computes one candidate activity at a time; public report batching is measured separately.
CPU, RSS, whole-admission/fleet costs and live provider paths remain unmeasured.
readiness: 12 current-source linked-control samples preserve exact activity and durable state; active pending-work reads remain zero. Inactive/transfer/reopen controls pass. Counts only.
